name: District of Columbia
overview: In the District of Columbia there are no county sales: the Office of Tax and Revenue (OTR) holds one Annual Tax Lien Sale for real property with delinquent taxes, and the buyer gets a tax lien (certificate of sale), not the property. The 2026 sale was held in person at OTR's office on August 19 and 20, 2026, with a minimum deposit of 20 percent of the purchase price and the balance due within five business days. Liens not sold to bidders are bid off to the District and can then be bought over the counter online on weekdays. The lien earns interest of 1.5 percent per month on the sale amount; the owner can redeem until a court issues a final order in a foreclosure case, which the buyer may start six months after the last day of the sale if the taxes remain unpaid.

overview_sources.quote: within five (5) business days after the last day of the Tax Sale
1.5% per month or portion thereof on the sale amount, exclusive of surplus
beginning six (6) months after the last day of the sale
at any time prior to the issuance of a final order
Such tax liens can now be purchased for the amount for which the real property was bid-off to the District
OTC tax liens may be purchased online Monday through Friday (excluding holidays), from 8 am to 3 pm.

counties.next_sale_note: 2027 Annual Tax Lien Sale date not yet posted. The 2026 annual sale (August 19-20, 2026, in person at 1101 4th St SW) is over. Liens bid off to the District can be bought over the counter online on weekdays, with block-out periods around the annual sale.
counties.how_to_bid: Annual sale (2026 rules): register at MyTax.DC.gov, bring a minimum deposit of 20% of your total purchase budget, bid in person with your number card, and pay the balance within five business days after the last day of the sale. Over the counter: buy liens bid off to the District online Monday through Friday, 8 am to 3 pm, and pay in full the same day at OTR's Cashier's Office or by wire. OTR posts a buyer's book, FAQ and sale list on its tax lien sale page.
